d:
California Attorney General Rob Bonta says his office will press ahead with its civil investigation of Nvidia, arguing US Attorney General Todd Blanche appeared to have “prejudged” the company’s conduct by calling it a “good corporate citizen.” Bonta says California has subpoenaed Nvidia to determine whether China obtained advanced chips or confidential information and whether the company misled investors and the public. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
More on Bloomberg Television and Markets
